events.subject: Three experiences: shared core, /view, /how, /share; SMART Imaging sandbox; scaled decode; JPEG-LS perf; coordination docs

events.subject: Whole-slide tiled viewer in /view; bootstrap deploy scripts; wasm build fix

events.label: IDC long-tail sweep
events.subject: Long-tail IDC sweep: 9,557 instances, random control 1000/1000 (95% CI 99.62-100%), all 9,537 evaluated 99.84%; 8 new cases; Leica YBR_FULL_422 ruling max_abs 3; corpus 942/942

events.label: Sample data: Josh Example
events.subject: Sample data: Josh Example (de-identified MRI, CT, radiographs from my-health-data 911ee41) plus the CC BY slide

events.label: Decoders: float, every JPEG mode
events.subject: Decoders: float pixel data, .1.98/.8.1, GE private BE, files without Part 10 meta, retired photometrics, all JPEG modes (progressive, arithmetic, hierarchical), JPEG XL, JPEG 2000 Part 2

events.label: Resumable uploads
events.subject: Uploads ride out network drops; upload protocol follows draft-ietf-httpbis-resumable-upload-13

events.label: One encrypted file per study
events.subject: Study files review: positive lengths and non-empty series; a study-level linked-file only when used; subset rule in §8.1; reports follow studies in Rust subsets; streaming CLI packer; real upload limits; renames

events.label: Local or S3 storage
events.subject: Blob store: local files or a private S3 bucket (rusty-s3), proxy or redirect reads, refcounted blobs for clones, multipart staging for resumable uploads; files table and helper renames

events.label: Display checked against dcmtk and pydicom
events.subject: Display: one pipeline for every pixel path, LUT output depth both ways, conformance against dcmtk and pydicom; GPU reformats with slabs; /view sample empty state

events.label: Phone layout
events.subject: View on phones: one More menu (report, downloads, encryption), Display and Measure in bottom sheets, no slice bar for single images, study times when dates repeat; Reset restores the series' opening view; overflow audit at 320-480 px, both orientations, 100% and 200% text

events.label: Sandbox: transfer-syntax negotiation (PR #5)
events.subject: Sandbox: WADO-RS transfer syntax negotiation (smart-imaging PR #5)

events.label: Lossless compression when sharing
events.subject: Lossless compression when packing: SMART retrieve asks for JPEG Lossless first; uncompressed images re-encoded in workers (SV1 by default, JPEG 2000 when the encoder offers it, or kept exact), staged with hashes for resume; owner-only note; seed compresses the sample; checks verify pixel identity

events.label: Lossless JPEG encoder and transcoder
events.subject: Lossless SV1 encoder and Part 10 transcoder (shl-dicom-transcode), with wasm export
